description: Source code for GuzzleHttp's StreamHandler class, implementing an HTTP handler using PHP's stream wrapper, including request handling, response creation, error handling, and stream management.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler class that uses PHP's stream wrapper to send HTTP requests and process responses, including error handling, stream decoding, and stream management.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles sending an HTTP request using PHP streams, manages delays, protocol versions, and error handling.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the 'on_stats' callback with transfer statistics if provided.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a PSR-7 Response object from stream headers and body, handling decoding and headers.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a stream sink for response body, based on options.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Automatically decodes gzip or deflate content if instructed, adjusting headers accordingly.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains data from source stream into sink stream, respecting content length.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a stream resource with error handling.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource for the request, handling context, headers, and host resolution.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves the host in the URI, optionally forcing IPv4 or IPv6 resolution.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Builds default stream context options based on the request.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Adds proxy configuration to request options based on provided proxy URL.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses proxy URL into stream context format, including authentication.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Adds timeout setting to request options.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Adds SSL crypto method to options if valid.

methods.name: add_verify
methods.description: Configures SSL verification options.

methods.name: add_cert
methods.description: Adds SSL certificate options.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Adds progress notification callback.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Adds debug notification callback for stream events.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Helper to add notification callbacks to parameters.

methods.name: callArray
methods.description: Combines multiple callbacks into one callable.
